_design_notes.core_change: EMANDATE_MAIN is always the starting workflow. When user selects an auth mode (e.g. NET_BANKING), the system transitions directly into the initial action state of that subflow — skipping any repeated greeting or intro.

transition_types.STATE: Stays in the same workflow, moves to target state_id
transition_types.SUBFLOW: Switches to a different workflow_id, starting at subflow_entry_state

field_guide.bot_says_hi: What the bot speaks when entering this state (Hindi)
field_guide.confirmation_question_hi: The yes/no question bot asks after bot_says to confirm action done
field_guide.advance_signals: Customer words/phrases meaning DONE — triggers transition to next state
field_guide.stuck_signals: Customer words/phrases meaning HELP/ERROR — triggers inline help, then resume
field_guide.resume_prompt_hi: What bot says after resolving a stuck/query before re-asking confirmation_question
field_guide.on_advance: State to move to when customer confirms done (for simple linear transitions)
field_guide.transitions: Event-keyed map for branching transitions — use this when multiple outcomes are possible

what_is_mandate.answer_hi: Mandate ek permission hai jo bank ko deti hain — isse EMI har mahine automatically account se debit hoti hai, manually pay nahi karna hota.
what_is_mandate.answer_en: A mandate is a permission you give your bank to automatically debit your EMI each month — so you never miss a payment.

is_safe.answer_hi: Bilkul safe hai. Yeh NPCI aur aapke bank ke official secure page ke through hota hai. Main kabhi bhi aapka password nahi poonchungi.
is_safe.answer_en: Completely safe. This goes through NPCI and your bank's own official secure page. I will never ask for your password.

no_money_today.answer_hi: Aaj koi paisa nahi katega. Sirf permission register ho rahi hai. Pehla debit aapki EMI due date par hoga.
no_money_today.answer_en: No money is deducted today. We are only registering the permission. The first debit happens on your EMI due date.

WAIT.response_hi: Koi baat nahi, main wait karungi. Jab ready ho to 'ready hoon' bolein.
WAIT.response_en: No problem, I will wait. Say 'I am ready' when you want to continue.

states.title: Select Language
states.bot_says_en: {customer_name}. Welcome to e-mandate registration. Please choose your language. For English, say English. Hindi ke liye, Hindi bolein.
states.bot_says_hi: {customer_name}. Welcome to e-mandate registration. Please choose your language. For English, say English. Hindi ke liye, Hindi bolein.

states.title: Initial Greeting and Consent to Proceed
states.bot_says_hi: Namaste. Mein ek automated assistant hu aur aapko e-mandate registration ke liye guide karungi.
states.bot_says_en: Hello, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of [Company Name]. I'll guide you through your e-mandate registration. Shall we proceed
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aap abhi shuru karna chahenge?
states.confirmation_question_en: Would you like to proceed now?
states.resume_prompt_hi: To, kya hum shuru karein?
states.resume_prompt_en: So, shall we begin?

states.title: Verify Form Details
states.bot_says_hi: Aapke screen par jo form khula hai, usme aapka naam, bank account number, EMI amount aur dates dikh rahe honge. Kripya teen cheezon ko verify karein
states.bot_says_en: On the form open on your screen, you should see your name, bank account number, EMI amount, and dates. Please verify three things — name is correct, bank account number is correct, and amount is correct.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapki saari details sahi hain?
states.confirmation_question_en: Are all your details correct?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Achha. Kripya details dobara check karein — naam, account number, aur amount sab sahi hona chahiye.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay. Please check the details again — name, account number, and amount all need to be correct.

states.title: Select Authentication Mode
states.bot_says_hi: Aapko screen par kuch authentication options dikhenge — Net Banking, Debit Card, PAN ya Customer ID, Aadhaar, aur eSign. Kripya apna preferred option select karein.
states.bot_says_en: On your screen you will see authentication options — Net Banking, Debit Card, PAN or Customer ID, Aadhaar, and eSign. Please select your preferred option.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Aapne kaunsa option select kiya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Which option have you selected?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Theek hai. Screen par Net Banking, Debit Card, PAN, Aadhaar, ya eSign mein se ek select karein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay. Please select one of the options on screen — Net Banking, Debit Card, PAN, Aadhaar, or eSign.

states.title: Customer not ready — polite exit
states.bot_says_hi: Koi baat nahi. Link 15 din tak active rahegi — jab bhi ready ho tab khol kar khud complete kar sakte hain. Koi zaroorat ho toh call karein. Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!
states.bot_says_en: No problem at all. The link stays active for 15 days — you can open it and complete it yourself whenever you are ready. Call us if you need any help. Thank you, have a great day!

states.title: Escalate — details incorrect, do not proceed
states.bot_says_hi: Bilkul ruk jaayein — Proceed bilkul mat dabayein. Aapki details galat hain. Main ye call yahan band karti hoon aur aapki details correct karwa ke nayi link bhejti hoon. Thodi der mein nayi link milegi.
states.bot_says_en: Please stop completely — do not click Proceed. Your details are incorrect. I will end this call and arrange corrections and send you a fresh link. A new link will reach you shortly.

states.title: Verify mandate summary — Proceed then Yes
states.bot_says_hi: Net Banking ke liye — pehle screen par apna naam, bank account number, aur EMI amount ek baar aur verify karein. Sab sahi ho toh Proceed button dabayein, phir ek popup aayega — usme Yes button dabayein.
states.bot_says_en: For Net Banking — first verify your name, bank account number, and EMI amount one more time on screen. If all correct, click Proceed, then a popup will appear — click Yes on it.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne Proceed aur phir Yes daba diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you clicked Proceed and then Yes?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Theek hai. Wapas aate hain — details verify karke Proceed aur phir Yes dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay, coming back — verify details and click Proceed then Yes.

states.title: Confirm NPCI page has loaded
states.bot_says_hi: Page ab NPCI ke secure server par redirect ho raha hai. Aapko ek loading screen dikhegi, phir ek page aayega jisme upar NPCI ka logo hoga.
states.bot_says_en: The page is now redirecting to NPCI's secure server. You will see a loading screen, then a page with the NPCI logo at the top.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aap NPCI page par pahunch gaye hain?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you reached the NPCI page?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Theek hai. Jab NPCI page load ho jaye aur logo dikh jaaye tab batayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay. Let me know when the NPCI page loads and you can see the NPCI logo.

states.title: Tick T&C checkbox and click Submit on NPCI
states.bot_says_hi: Is page par neeche ek checkbox hoga — Terms and Conditions ke liye. Pehle woh checkbox tick karein, phir Submit button dabayein. Checkbox tick kiye bina Submit kaam nahi karega.
states.bot_says_en: On this page there is a checkbox at the bottom for Terms and Conditions. First tick that checkbox, then click Submit. Submit will not work without ticking the checkbox first.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne checkbox tick karke Submit daba diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you ticked the checkbox and clicked Submit?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Achha. NPCI page par neeche checkbox tick karein, phir Submit dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay — on the NPCI page tick the checkbox at the bottom, then click Submit.

states.title: Log in with Net Banking credentials
states.bot_says_hi: Ab aapke bank ka secure login page khul chuka hoga. Yahan apna Net Banking User ID aur Password dhyan se enter karein. Yeh aapka ATM PIN nahi hai — wahi credentials use karein jo aap bank ki official website ya app me login karne ke liye use karte hain.
states.bot_says_en: The secure login page of your bank should now be open. Carefully enter your Net Banking User ID and Password. This is not your ATM PIN — use the same credentials you use to log in on your bank’s official website or app.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Jab aap login details enter kar lein, mujhe batayein. Main yahin wait kar rahi hoon.
states.confirmation_question_en: Let me know once you have entered your login details. I’ll wait here.
states.resume_prompt_hi: Theek hai. Bank ke login page par net banking User ID aur Password enter karein — ATM PIN nahi.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay — on the bank login page enter your Internet Banking User ID and Password, not your ATM PIN.

FORGOT_PASSWORD.response_hi: Koi baat nahi. Pehle apne bank ki website par jaake password reset karein. Jab naya password mil jaaye tab mujhe batayein — link 15 din tak active rahegi.
FORGOT_PASSWORD.response_en: No problem. Please visit your bank's website to reset your password first. Once done, let me know — the link stays active for 15 days.

ATM_PIN_CONFUSION.response_hi: ATM PIN nahi — net banking User ID aur Password chahiye. Jo aap bank ki website ya app par login ke liye use karte hain.
ATM_PIN_CONFUSION.response_en: Not the ATM PIN — you need your net banking User ID and Password. The ones you use to log in to your bank's website or app.

NO_NET_BANKING.response_hi: Koi baat nahi. Main aapko Debit Card ya Aadhaar wali link bhej sakti hoon — usi se bhi ho jaayega.
NO_NET_BANKING.response_en: No problem. I can send you a fresh link for Debit Card or Aadhaar authentication instead.

states.title: Enter OTP from bank
states.bot_says_hi: Bank ab aapke registered mobile number par ek OTP bhejega — 6 digit ka code. Woh OTP screen par enter karein aur Submit karein. Main wait karungi.
states.bot_says_en: Your bank will now send a 6-digit OTP to your registered mobile number. Please enter that OTP on screen and click Submit. I will wait.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya OTP aa gaya aur aapne submit kar diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Did you receive the OTP and submit it?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Achha. OTP ka wait karein, aaye toh screen par enter karein aur Submit karein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Okay — wait for the OTP, once it arrives enter it on screen and click Submit.

OTP_NOT_RECEIVED.response_hi: 30-60 second wait karein. Network signal check karein. Screen par 'Resend OTP' ka option bhi hoga — woh try karein.
OTP_NOT_RECEIVED.response_en: Please wait 30 to 60 seconds. Check your network signal. Also look for a Resend OTP button on screen and try that.

OTP_EXPIRED.response_hi: OTP usually 5 minute valid hota hai. Screen par 'Resend OTP' button dhundhein aur click karein — nayi OTP aayegi.
OTP_EXPIRED.response_en: OTP is usually valid for 5 minutes. Look for the Resend OTP button on screen and click it — a new OTP will be sent.

states.title: 10-second hold — do not close browser
states.bot_says_hi: Bahut achha! Ab page process kar raha hai — please 10 second tak browser band mat karein aur back button bhi mat dabayein. Page khud hi agle page par redirect ho jayega.
states.bot_says_en: Excellent! The page is now processing — please do not close the browser or press back for 10 seconds. The page will automatically redirect on its own.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya page badal gaya ya koi naya page aa gaya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Has the page changed or a new page appeared?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Koi baat nahi. Agar mandate process ho gayi toh status khud update ho jaayega. Abhi — kya page badla?
states.resume_prompt_en: No problem. If the mandate processed, status will update automatically. Now — has the page changed?

states.title: Mandate registered successfully
states.bot_says_hi: Congratulations! Aapka e-mandate successfully register ho gaya! Screen par aapko ek UMRN number dikh raha hoga — yeh aapke mandate ka unique ID hai, ise note kar lein. Aage se aapki EMI har mahine automatically account se debit hogi.
states.bot_says_en: Congratulations! Your e-mandate is successfully registered! You will see a UMRN number on screen — this is your mandate's unique ID, please note it down. From now your EMI will be automatically debited each month.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapke koi aur sawaal hain — amount, frequency, cancellation, ya kuch aur?
states.confirmation_question_en: Do you have any other questions — about the amount, frequency, cancellation, or anything else?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Aur koi sawaal?
states.resume_prompt_en: Any other questions?

states.title: Close the call
states.bot_says_hi: Dhanyavaad! [Company Name] ke saath registration complete karne ke liye bahut bahut shukriya. Aapka din shubh ho!
states.bot_says_en: Thank you so much for completing your registration with [Company Name]. Have a wonderful day!

states.title: Proceed then Yes on mandate summary
states.bot_says_hi: Debit Card ke liye — screen par details verify karein. Sab sahi ho toh Proceed dabayein, phir popup par Yes dabayein.
states.bot_says_en: For Debit Card — verify the details on screen. If all correct, click Proceed, then click Yes on the popup.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne Proceed aur Yes daba diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you clicked Proceed and then Yes?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Details verify karke Proceed aur Yes dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Verify details and click Proceed then Yes.

states.title: NPCI redirect
states.bot_says_hi: Page NPCI ke secure server par redirect ho raha hai.
states.bot_says_en: The page is redirecting to NPCI's secure server.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya NPCI page load ho gaya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Has the NPCI page loaded?
states.resume_prompt_hi: NPCI page load hone ka wait karein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Wait for the NPCI page to load.

states.title: Enter debit card details
states.bot_says_hi: Ab screen par apna Debit Card number, expiry date, aur CVV enter karein aur Submit dabayein. CVV card ke peeche hota hai — 3 digit ka number.
states.bot_says_en: Now enter your Debit Card number, expiry date, and CVV on screen and click Submit. CVV is on the back of your card — a 3-digit number.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne card details submit kar diye?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you submitted your card details?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Card number, expiry, aur CVV enter karein phir Submit dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Enter card number, expiry, and CVV then click Submit.

states.title: Enter OTP
states.bot_says_hi: Aapko bank se OTP aayega. Woh OTP enter karein aur Submit dabayein.
states.bot_says_en: You will receive an OTP from your bank. Enter that OTP and click Submit.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya OTP submit ho gaya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Has the OTP been submitted?
states.resume_prompt_hi: OTP enter karein aur Submit dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Enter the OTP and click Submit.

states.title: Mandate registered
states.bot_says_hi: Aapka Debit Card e-mandate successfully register ho gaya! UMRN number note kar lein. Aage se EMI automatically debit hogi.
states.bot_says_en: Your Debit Card e-mandate is successfully registered! Please note down your UMRN number. Your EMI will be automatically debited going forward.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Aur koi sawaal?
states.confirmation_question_en: Any other questions?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Aur koi sawaal?
states.resume_prompt_en: Any other questions?

states.title: Close the call
states.bot_says_hi: Dhanyavaad! Registration ke liye bahut shukriya. Aapka din shubh ho!
states.bot_says_en: Thank you for completing your registration. Have a wonderful day!

states.title: Proceed then Yes
states.bot_says_hi: PAN ya Customer ID ke liye — screen par details verify karke Proceed aur phir Yes dabayein.
states.bot_says_en: For PAN or Customer ID — verify details on screen, then click Proceed and then Yes.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne Proceed aur Yes daba diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you clicked Proceed and then Yes?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Details verify karke Proceed aur Yes dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Verify details and click Proceed then Yes.

states.title: Accept disclaimer
states.bot_says_hi: Ab ek Disclaimer page aayega. Usse padh kar scroll karein aur consent checkbox tick karke Proceed dabayein.
states.bot_says_en: A disclaimer page will appear. Read it, scroll down, tick the consent checkbox, and click Proceed.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya disclaimer accept ho gaya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you accepted the disclaimer?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Disclaimer page par scroll karein, checkbox tick karein, phir Proceed dabayein.

states.title: Enter PAN or Customer ID
states.bot_says_hi: AB screen par apna PAN number ya Customer ID enter karein aur Submit dabayein. PAN 10 character ka hota hai. Customer ID aapki passbook ke pehle page par hoti hai.
states.bot_says_en: Now enter your PAN number or Customer ID on screen and click Submit. PAN is 10 characters. Customer ID is on the first page of your passbook.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya PAN ya Customer ID submit ho gaya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you submitted your PAN or Customer ID?
states.resume_prompt_hi: PAN ya Customer ID enter karke Submit dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Enter your PAN or Customer ID then click Submit.

states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya OTP submit ho gaya?

states.resume_prompt_hi: OTP enter karein aur Submit dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Enter the OTP and click Submit.

states.bot_says_en: For Aadhaar — verify details on screen, then click Proceed and then Yes.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne Proceed aur Yes daba diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you clicked Proceed and then Yes?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Details verify karke Proceed aur Yes dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Verify details and click Proceed then Yes.

states.resume_prompt_en: Enter the Aadhaar OTP and click Submit.

states.title: Mandate registered

states.bot_says_en: Your Aadhaar e-mandate is successfully registered! Please note your UMRN number.

states.confirmation_question_en: Any other questions?

states.resume_prompt_en: Any other questions?

states.title: Close the call

states.title: Consent page — click Submit
states.bot_says_hi: eSign ke liye — screen par ek consent page aayega. Use padh kar Submit button dabayein.
states.bot_says_en: For eSign — a consent page will appear on screen. Read it and click the Submit button.
states.confirmation_question_hi: Kya aapne Submit daba diya?
states.confirmation_question_en: Have you clicked Submit?
states.resume_prompt_hi: Consent page par Submit dabayein.
states.resume_prompt_en: Click Submit on the consent page.

states.confirmation_question_en: Have you entered your Aadhaar and clicked Send OTP?
